name: bb-plugin-bb-lively
description: bb plugin: a motion layer of micro-interactions for bb at three intensities, honouring reduced motion, plus Lively palette themes.

bb.name: Lively [Experimental]
bb.description: Motion for bb on any theme, from subtle to bold: springy presses, new messages rising in, menu springs, a send burst, status rings, breathing glows. One intensity setting; follows your OS reduced-motion setting. Plus optional Lively palettes.

themes.name: Lively
themes.description: Warm neutrals, a soft violet accent, rounder corners and springier transitions

themes.name: Lively Dracula
themes.description: bb's Dracula palette with Lively's corners, elevation and transition timing

themes.name: Lively Bold
themes.description: Lively with the accent turned up: tinted selection, accent focus and glowing elevation

themes.name: Lively Dracula Bold
themes.description: Lively Dracula with the accent turned up: tinted selection, accent focus and glowing elevation

scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace core && oxlint --config core/.oxlintrc.json --type-aware app.tsx server.ts adapter tests
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && bb plugin build
